Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the film title “Dilan 1991” as the release year and combined it with IMDb’s month-day (2019-02-28) to fabricate a 1991-02-28 release date. Reliable sources indicate Dilan 1991 was released in 2019, while Celine: Through the Eyes of the World was released in 2010, so Celine came out first. The error was a faulty synthesis of data that contradicted the verified 2019 release year.
